snippet.title: Mafia Mario Reveal Trailer (Super Smash Bros. Brawl mod)
snippet.description:
The trailer for my new and improved Mafia Mario moveset mod!

If you're interested in modding Super Smash Bros. Brawl, you can download the mod here:
Gamebanana - https://gamebanana.com/mods/432265
Brawl Vault - http://forums.kc-mm.com/Gallery/BrawlView.php?Number=221428

Music Credits:
- New Donk City but in Minor Key (0.7x speed) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OMNYbkX1MsY
